verticalDatum: RGE ALTI service working elevations, EPSG2154. Effective acquisition date and old BD TOPO building-base absolute tie are not verified.

sources.encoding: Float32 GeoTIFF, actual elevations; not a colorized height image.

courtFloorMethod: Open main-court controls plus0.12m; raised inner keep court reconstructed at that shared working level. Under-keep crop interpolates moat-height ground through its raised inner court and is not a surveyed floor control. Chapel uses separate nearby ground controls.
limits: The DTM interpolates moat-height ground across the keep court and lower heights into some building footprints. The raised keep court and bounded foundations are reconstructed using open main-court controls, not a claim of surveyed floor levels.

Older BD TOPO base/roof altitude fields disagree with this working DTM by up to several meters. Published relative keep height is retained; incompatible absolute roof fields do not control placement. Acquisition date and exact current entrance/bridge grades remain unverified.
One-meter source and two-meter diagnostic sampling are not survey accuracy. Bounded foundations fill only architecture and the reconstructed inner court. No full-site slab or terrain cutout.
Bridge slopes and masonry batters are bounded exterior reconstructions; no walkable interiors or exact present-day structural survey.
